title: Sharp Bohr and Bohr-Rogosinski inequalities involving area measure for close-to-convex harmonic mappings
summary: In this article, we investigate refined and generalized versions of the Bohr and Bohr--Rogosinski inequalities for a normalized subclass $\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{H}}^{0}(α)$ ($0 \le α< 1$) of univalent close-to-convex harmonic mappings $f = h + \overline{g}$ defined on the open unit disk $\mathbb{D} \subset \mathbb{C}$. By incorporating non-negative monotone increasing functions associated with the planar area integral $S_r/π$ of the image domain $f(\mathbb{D}_r)$, we establish new sharp Bohr-type inequalities expressed in terms of the Euclidean distance $d(f(0), \partial f(\mathbb{D}))$.…
